name: uberasm-aimed-bullet-bill-eerie-generator
title: Aimed Bullet Bill / Eerie Generator
description: This code generates Bullet Bills or Eeries from the side Mario is facing, and at his height, creating a totally predictable pattern as opposed to SMW's.

name: uberasm-baby-yoshi-disappears-after-eating-too-much
title: Baby Yoshi Disappears After Eating Too Much
description:
Sequel to "Yoshi Disappears After Eating Too Much", this code does exactly what the title says, with a configurable amount of sprites that must be eaten. It also prevents Baby Yoshi from ever growing up, and there's an option so powerups also don't make him grow up instantly (but just count as 1 eat).

Requested by Picayune.

versions.title: Baby Yoshi Disappears After Eating Too Much

name: uberasm-balloon-trigger
title: Balloon Trigger
description:
This LevelASM allows you to enable or disable the P-Balloon state by pressing a configurable button (R or L by default).

Code written by anonimzwx but published by me at his request

name: uberasm-configurable-amount-of-baby-yoshi-eats
title: Configurable Amount of Baby Yoshi Eats
description: This simple code will change the required amount of things Baby Yoshi has to eat to grow up for the level you put it in (or for all levels, if used in gamemode 14). Note that powerups will still make him grow immediately, and "double eats" still apply (if he eats 2 things in quick succession, it will count as 3).

versions.title: Configurable Amount of Baby Yoshi Eats

name: uberasm-custom-overworld-level-names
title: Custom Overworld Level Names
description: This UberASM is meant as an alternative/replacement to the "Extended Overworld Level Names"  patch, allowing you to have longer level names than what Lunar Magic supports. Compared to the patch, it comes with some options to configure the names easily: how many lines they have, how long the lines are and where the names are positioned. It also allows you to change the palette of some parts of the names.

name: uberasm-customizable-high-and-low-tides
title: Customizable "High and Low" Tides
description: This UberASM allows you to have a different behavior for the "high and low" tides on a level basis. What you can change is: time between tide movements, Y speed, Y acceleration, high and low position. It requires 7 bytes of freeram and to apply the provided patch with Asar. For more info and instructions, check out the readme file.

name: uberasm-customizable-mid-air-jumps
title: Customizable Mid-Air Jumps
description:
This gives Mario the ability to perform and store multiple midair jumps.

This ASM is customizable:
- Ground, swimming, and climbing reset behavior
- Separate reset amounts for each state
- Upward midair jumps
- B/A or L/R controls
- Spin jumping while holding an item
- Cape-flight jumps, flight preservation, and flight spin jumps
- Normal and spin jump heights
- Number of jumps granted by the custom coin
- Maximum number of stored jump

name: uberasm-dynamic-sprites-utility
title: Dynamic Sprites Utility
description:
A resource that enables dynamic sprites to be used.

Unlike the patch, this allows the graphics region used by dynamic sprites to be remapped (instead of always using the bottom half of SP4), bumps the limit of dynamic sprites on screen from four to six and includes a few other features. It's also generally more optimal and, aside from an option to uninstall the old patch, doesn't do any hijacks.

Refer to the readme (enclosed in the download or here) for more details and instructions on installing it and using the features!

NOTE: Dynamic sprites from the section will not be compatible with this: the conversions must be used instead.

name: uberasm-event-based-triggers
title: Event-Based Triggers
description: This is a simple UberASM to help with controlling the flags for Conditional Direct Map16 and custom ExAnimation triggers on level load, based on whether certain events have been activated.

name: uberasm-exit-percentage-on-the-overworld
title: Exit Percentage on the Overworld
description:
This UberASM will display the current progress in the hack (as percentage of exits gotten) on the overworld border. It can be paired with this patch for consistency. Check out the readme for more information.
This is the second part of Ondore's Lies' request for a percentage counter on file select and overworld.

name: uberasm-fade-from-title-screen-to-file-select-menu
title: Fade from Title Screen to File Select Menu
description:
This resource allows you to slowly transition from the title screen to the file select menu.

There's two files, one of which is meant to be inserted always in game modes 06 and 07, and another you optionally need to insert in game mode 03.

versions.title: Fade from Title Screen to File Select Menu
versions.filename: Fade From Title Screen to File Select Menu.zip

name: uberasm-fair-powerup-filters
title: Fair Powerup Filters
description:
This lets you set up 4 types of powerup filters in a per-level basis: small only, big only, no fire flowers and no feathers, taking in account your powerup status and item box item. Unlike most powerup filters though, this won't simply make you lose a filtered powerup, but will restore it once you return to the overworld, much like the Yoshi filters work. For that, 1 byte of free RAM is used.

Additional notes:
-Filtering a fire flower or a feather will replace it with a mushroom.
-There are 2 recovery options for fire flower and feather filters: they can always be recovered, or it can depend on whether the mushroom they got turned into has been preserved. More details in the readme and setup files.

Note that these aren't to be used as level code, but as game modes C and 12! An easy table to set up the activation of the filters is included.

name: uberasm-filter-items-when-exiting-pipe
title: Filter Items When Exiting Pipe
description:
This resource allows you to disable bringing any item you carry through a pipe while keeping the pipe animation.

There are two variants included in here:
  • filter_item_pipe_total.asm
    will erase any carried item you bring in the level you insert this at.
  • filer_item_pipe_conditional.asm
    will erase carried items depending on the value of a secondary exit. Useful when you have many pipes in one level and want to filter items from some of them only.

versions.title: Filter Items When Exiting Pipe
versions.filename: Filter Items When Exiting Pipe V1.0.1.zip

name: uberasm-free-7e-0de0-7e-0ef4
title: Free $7E:0DE0-$7E:0EF4
description: This simple code frees up the 277 (0x115) bytes of RAM at $7E:0DE0-$7E:0EF4 (a.k.a. $0DE0-$0EF4) for usage in levels, so that it can be used as free RAM without messing up overworld sprites. This can be useful for resources that need a lot of free RAM in the $0000-$1FFF area.

name: uberasm-gliding-parachute
title: Gliding Parachute
description:
This uberasm adds the ability to use a
parachute while Mario is in the air. By pressing the B button during
a fall, Mario will deploy a parachute that slows his descent,
allowing him to glide gently downward.

The uberasm is designed to be highly configurable, allowing
customization of color palettes, visual effects, sounds, and more.


Requested by Final Theory
This was #30 on Final Theory’s list of ASM challenges

name: uberasm-graphical-air-meter
title: Graphical Air Meter
description: This is basically similar to the sprite version, but recoded from scratch, and more customizability. The amount of time the player can be in the water, unlike the sprite version, can be any value rather than restricted to powers of 2 "ticks" (which happens at every !CountDownFrequency+1 frames) starting at 255 units.

name: uberasm-level-timer-air-meter
title: Level Timer Air Meter
description:
This UberASM code reworks the level timer to be used as an air meter for the level it has been inserted, allowing for an easily insertable air meter.

Includes a version which is set by extra bytes and a version set by defines in the ASM file.

name: uberasm-multi-step-autoscroll
title: Multi-step Autoscroll
description:
This code allows you to create your own special autoscroll that goes where you want at the speed you want, much like the generator used in Butter Bridge 1 (level 00C) in the original game.

It works by using tables where you store X/Y speeds for each step of the autoscroll. It allows the use of fractional speeds and can be paused/resumed anytime you want using a flag. Plus, all the free RAM used can be easily changed to avoid conflicts, and the whole scrolling code can either stop or loop when it reaches the end of the tables.

Details in .asm file.

name: uberasm-new-super-mario-bros-rising-water
title: New Super Mario Bros. Rising Water
description:
This will make the layer 3 tide water rise when a specified switch is activated.

Make sure to set the layer 3 settings to "low tide only".

Video

versions.title: New Super Mario Bros. Rising Water

name: uberasm-new-super-mario-bros-wii-styled-secret-passages
title: New Super Mario Bros. Wii Styled Secret Passages
description: This UberASM will hide layer 2 while Mario is near it, which can be used to reveal secret passages like how New Super Mario Bros. Wii handles its secret passages. You can either have the spotlight around Mario always active or only appear when a certain trigger is activated (such as $14AF).

versions.title: New Super Mario Bros. Wii Styled Secret Passages

name: uberasm-nintendo-presents-secret-code
title: Nintendo Presents Secret Code
description:
This UberASM allows you to enter a secret code via a button combination on the Nintendo Presents screen. When the code is entered, it'll either set a configurable RAM address or warp you to a sublevel of your choosing. Can be used for all sorts of purposes.

Has a hijack to change the timing of when GFX32/GF33 are decompressed, so that doesn't interfere with entering the code.

Requested by Gamer collin.

name: uberasm-no-overworld
title: No Overworld
description: Originally inspired by a resource from Alcaro, and does pretty much the same thing: disables returning to overworld after beating levels and instead has the player go through levels in a sequence, either in numerical order or in an order defined by you.

name: uberasm-one-mind
title: One Mind
description:
This ASM switches randomly between the current players (in-game), while also warning them with sound effects, before that happens. It can be inserted into nearly every hack, with no previous UberASM-Gamemode on it. (SA-1 Works!)
It is meant to be inserted into an already existing hack, but if you're a creator and want to build anything around this, go for it ;)

It was highly inspired by IsoFrieze's 'SMW One Mind' and also uses the same sound effects. (default)

Refer to readme.txt on how to insert it and for further information ;)

I made it highly customizable, so that multiple things can be changed (Sound effects, etc.)

This ASM is just for fun and is meant for two players and two controllers. (How would you even play it with one? ;) )

I hope you have fun with it!

-badummzi

name: uberasm-overworld-exit-counter
title: Overworld Exit Counter
description: A simple UberASM code to display the exit counter on the overworld border.

name: uberasm-overworld-songs-based-on-event
title: Overworld Songs Based on Event
description: This UberASM will make each OW submap have a different song when a certain event has been passed (it only works properly if using AddmusicK). Make sure to check out the included readme file for instructions on how to use it.

name: uberasm-overworld-text-display
title: Overworld Text Display
description: This UberASM will display some text/info on the Overworld layer 3 depending on the level Mario is standing on. Meant to be used for collabs to show the level's author name on the border, but you can use it for other stuff too. Check out the readme for instructions.

name: uberasm-password-system
title: Password System
description:
With this code, you can easily create a unique password system for your level. Define inputs that have to be done in the correct order and one of these things will happen:
  • Kill the player
  • Hurt the player
  • Give the player 1-UP(s)
  • Give the player a Power-UP
  • Give the player some coins
  • Give the player Star-Power
  • End the level (normal exit)
  • End the level (secret exit), triggers the keyhole animation
  • Spawn a sprite
  • Change ON/OFF Switch state
  • Activate P-Switch
  • Teleport to current screen exit
  • Teleport the player to the overworld, no event triggered
  • Teleport the player to a different overworld position

Every option is very customizable, so make sure to change the defines in the asm file.

name: uberasm-peach-s-floating-ability
title: Peach's Floating Ability
description: This will give the player a floaty jump, similar to Peach's own in Super Mario Bros. 2.

name: uberasm-player-animated-tiles-exgfx
title: Player + Animated Tiles ExGFX
description: This UberASM allows you to insert different ExGFX files for GFX32 and 33 (player and animations GFX) on a sublevel, submap and cutscene basis. It's similar to the patch by Roy, but with a few key differences explained in the README. Mainly, it doesn't have issues on SA-1 (that I know of), and it should have faster loading times in some cases. Additionally you can also change GFX manually with code, if you want to go more advanced. Anyway, make sure to check the README for insertion instructions and whatnot.

name: uberasm-press-r-to-switch-characters
title: Press R to Switch Characters
description:
Whenever you press the R button, you will switch between Mario and Luigi! Keep in mind that whenever you switch characters, you will have to switch controllers, too. Unless you make use of this tweak.

Includes options for allowing Mario and Luigi to have separate coin counts, powerups, and item boxes. Separate lives is possible too, but was not included as setting Luigi's starting lives correctly would require a hijack. Also includes a helper UberASM that prevents problems on the overworld if exiting a level as the other character.

name: uberasm-press-r-to-switch-mario-and-luigi-on-the-overworld
title: Press R to Switch Mario and Luigi on the Overworld
description:
This will switch the player from Mario to Luigi and back when Pressing the R button on the overworld during a Single Player game while leaving the 2 Player option intact.

It will take Mario's Score, Bonus Stars, Powerups, Yoshi's, overworld position and completely allows you to swap players without any odd behaviors like some of the other versions of "Switch Characters" blocks or patches.

This will work with Smallhacker's Separate Player graphics patch to give Luigi separate graphics from Mario. Instructions in the UberASM.

Note: Does require a patch for asar that is included. It fixes the lives system so that you won't get weird behaviors when you get a game over as Luigi.

versions.title: Press R to Switch Mario and Luigi on the Overworld

name: uberasm-princess-peach-abilities-floating-charged-jump-bomber
title: Princess Peach Abilities (Floating / Charged Jump / Bomber)
description:
This UberASM allows the player to have the skills Peach had back in SMB2, including the Peach Bomber from SSB, the SMB2 Hi-Jump (Charged Jump) and the Floating Ability from SMB2.

Originally an Asar patch made by Ladida (Noobish Noobsicle and scepile3 are credited too), now unified, reconverted and reorganized into an unique UberASM for a better use by Black Goku... the changes were:

- Added additional customization and timers.
- Added a flag for the players in case they want to have only a player with the skills.
- Fixed the Cape bug from the Asar patch (and the ones that triggered restricting the skills in the powerups).

Notes of the original readme made by Ladida:
- Originally, the hi-jump was coded by Noobish Noobsicle and I just tweaked it. but now its been coded it from scratch.
- Originally, the float was a Yoshi Flutter by scepile3and I just edited it. but now its been coded it from scratch.

Credit to me is optional.

This is my first ASM conversion, so any suggestions are welcome.

SMW Styled Peach shown here belongs to LinkstormZ.

versions.title: Princess Peach Abilities (Floating / Charged Jump / Bomber)

name: uberasm-repeating-layer
title: Repeating Layer 3 Vertical Scroll
description:
This UberASM vertically scrolls a layer 3 background in a repeating pattern. Configuration includes autoscroll speed and speed to offset from layer 1.

Compatible with the vanilla status bar. (Unlike native layer 3 scrolling, the vanilla status bar will not be scrolled into the middle of the screen)

name: uberasm-retry-system
title: Retry System
description:
This is the modern Retry System that extends and improves the original patch by worldpeace. Its base features are the same as the old patch, but there's a lot of new functionalities and customizations available, which make it an useful tool also for projects where a retry system is not needed. Additionally, being implemented as an UberASM project, it features much less hijacks than the original patch, making it compatible with more resources. UberASM Tool version 2.1 or higher is required.

The main features implemented are:
- Level respawn on death without going to the Overworld (with prompt or instant)
- Customizable Retry prompt appearance (box/bar/minimal)
- Multiple midways per level
- Automatic midways when entering a sublevel
- Customizable sprite status bar that replaces the vanilla one
- Death counter
- Integrated save system to retain checkpoints and other things in SRAM
- Title screen death fix
- Counterbreak (state reset when respawning or going to the Overworld)
- Miscellaneous bug fixes

See Documentation for more details.

You can check out the repository here.

You can see the changelog here.

name: uberasm-reverse-controls
title: Reverse Controls
description:
This is a very user-friendly code that lets you switch certain buttons on the controller.

You can switch controls based on:
- Nothing - always switch the controls
- ON/OFF Switch
- P-Switch
- Star-Power
- Yoshi
- Water
Feel free to submit more options!

This code might be useful to create a unique ghosthouse/ghost themed level.

Set your options in the asm file!!!

Credit is optional, just don't claim it as your own.

name: uberasm-save-at-any-time-on-overworld
title: Save At Any Time On Overworld
description:
This handy UberASM gives you a couple different options for allowing you to save the game at any time on the overworld:

- Autosave when you move on the overworld and when exiting a level.
- Bring up the save prompt with a configurable button.
- Save upon pressing a configurable button.

It'll also optionally display an icon to indicate the game has saved.

This has two small hijacks that enable the save icon to appear when using the save prompt and when the intro march finishes for consistency.

Insert on all your overworld maps using *. Also, use this tweak to fix an edge case where the game will not autosave after clearing an event if both Mario doesn't move afterwards and the level is not a "No-Auto-Move" level. Also insert this patch to fix a vanilla quirk that can prevent the save icon from displaying.

Made for Yano_Felix.

versions.title: Save At Any Time On Overworld

name: uberasm-scrollable-hdma-gradients
title: "Scrollable" HDMA Gradients
description:
Let's be honest: HDMA gradients are, due to their nature, static to the screen. But other games somehow manage to manage to make them scroll (well, give the illusion of scrolling as remember, they're static by nature) without using any background! Don't worry now, it's time to officially have that kind of code in SMW (at least a proper release since years)!

Read the readme first.

Creation of compatible HDMA tables is done with Gradient Tool.

name: uberasm-slopes-hurt
title: Slopes Hurt
description:
Designates some slopes to hurt the player when stepped on

(To be used only with floor slopes, not ceiling slopes or other tiles)
(Does not work with layer 2)

To use, "tiles:" must contain the map16 number of the slopes tiles that should hurt.

Example map16 modifications in LM to match the .asm file:
copy 1AA to 300
1AF to 301
196 to 330
19B to 331
1A0 to 332
1A5 to 333
Alternatively, change the values under "tiles:" to match your map16

name: uberasm-smb2-styled-charged-jump
title: SMB2-styled Charged Jump
description:
When this code is used, the player can charge a jump by ducking for several frames, until the point they start to flash. While flashing, they can perform a higher jump. The configuration can be applied to all player characters, to a specific character or can be RAM flag dependent. Details and example on how to set and use the code are found all within the ASM file.

Defines to allow charging while riding Yoshi, charged jump/spinjump heights, SFX for charge ready and how long the player should duck to trigger the charge, as well as other options, are included.

name: uberasm-sonic-shields
title: Sonic Shields
description:
The shields from Sonic the Hedgehog in SMW, this UberASM has custom blocks and a patch alongside with it that is required for it to work, but you could also instead use the "Sonic Styled Powerdown" patch.

If you haven't played Sonic, these shields can absorb a hit (or more) for the player, and certain shields have helpful abilities.

They do not take sprite slots, only OAM slots, they do take SP1-4 GFX space though (at least one 16x16 tile)
Also, you *need* to insert this as levelASM, otherwise the shields won't display.

Make sure you check out the README.

name: uberasm-super-star-with-coins
title: Super Star With Coins
description:
Inspired by the powerup mechanic using rings in the Sonic the Hedgehog series. When Mario collects a certain number of coins, he can activate Starman powerup, accompanied by a "transformation animation".
The duration of the effect depends on the number of coins available. While Starman is active, Mario will lose 1 coin per second until he runs out.

This is my first resource on the site, and I tried to make it as customizable as possible. You can consult the Readme file for more details on customization.

Insert as level.

name: uberasm-ultimate-overworld-level-flags
title: Ultimate Overworld Level Flags
description:
With this code, you can check if any overworld level flags are set and if they are, set any other level flags (the ones on the right you can see in overworld level settings window). This allows you to open any path on the overworld, not only a path from the level you have just beaten.

Simply change the defines in the asm file.

Credit is optional, just don't claim it as your own.

name: uberasm-vertical-layer
title: Vertical Layer 2 Scroll
description:
This is essentially a recreation of the "Layer 2 Scroll" sprite (sprite EA) in UberASM form, with some improvements. Most notably, it now fully supports vertical scrolling in levels, and has full customization of the scrolling parameters.

Also compatible with the vanilla auto-scroll sprite out of the box, as well as LM's horizontal Layer 2 autoscroll if you tweak its RAM addresses slightly.

name: uberasm-wall-stick-jump
title: Wall Stick & Jump
description:
This code allows the player to stick to walls and perform wall jumps off them.

Credit is optional, but highly appreciated.

name: uberasm-wario-dash
title: Wario Dash
description:
This UberASM code will give you the ability to dash like Wario in a Wario Land game I haven't played. See the readme for insertion details.

Original description:
An updated version of my Wario Dash patch. This version changes a few things to fix some bugs. You no longer gain star power while dashing, but a sliding effect is simulated. As such, make sure enemies you want to be able to be killed by the dash are able to be killed by sliding (you can use Tweaker or whatever to enable that).

name: uberasm-wing-cap
title: Wing Cap
description:
MellyMellouange's old Wing Cap sprite, cleaned up, optimized, made LM3 compatible, bugfixed and converted to UberASM by Arinsu.

Gives the player the ability to fly: also includes an optional spinjump drill down and glide ability.

name: uberasm-x-ray-spotlight
title: X-Ray Spotlight
description:
This UberASM changes the spotlight sprite so instead of lighting up the area under it, it instead reveals layer 1 under it. Based on this level from my hack, MYSQ.

Note that this requires a small hijack to fix a visual bug that would occur on SA-1.

Requested by ILoveSMW.

name: uberasm-yoshi-coin-checker
title: Yoshi Coin Checker
description:
This code uploads different 8x8 tiles on layer 3 depending if all Yoshi coins have been collected in the level Mario is standing on or not, or if there are none to be collected at all.
Which tiles to use, their properties and position are highly customizable. See the .asm file for details.
It is advised to use this in conjunction with the SRAM/BWRAM Plus patch in order to save the player's progress made in collecting Yoshi coins.

name: uberasm-yoshi-disappears-after-eating-too-much
title: Yoshi Disappears After Eating Too Much
description: This UberASM will make so that Yoshi disappears in a puff of smoke after he eats (and swallows) a certain amount of sprites. Check out the readme for more details.

versions.title: Yoshi Disappears After Eating Too Much

name: uberasm-yoshi-wings-teleport-on-yoshi-mount
title: Yoshi Wings Teleport on Yoshi Mount
description:
This code will make the player get immediately teleported to the Yoshi wings stage when riding Yoshi. Might be best used with this patch.

Requested by Knight of Time.

versions.title: Yoshi Wings Teleport on Yoshi Mount
versions.filename: Yoshi Wings Teleport on Yoshi Mount V1.0.1.zip
